About this item

  • Vanilla candles for home scented with the inviting aroma of spiced apples and topped with creamy vanilla ice cream to create a cozy atmosphere and a warm ambience
  • Large Apothecary Jar Candles that provide up to 140 hours of fragrance; Dimensions are 3.8''L x 3.8''W x 6.75''H
  • Crafted with a soy wax blend to ensure a clean, even burn and a beautifully balanced fragrance experience. Its creamy, slow-burning formula enhances both performance and presentation, making it a perfect everyday luxury or gift
  • Our expertly optimized wicks ensure a clean, controlled burn that melts wax evenly across the surface. The result is a longer-lasting candle with a beautifully consistent fragrance experience
  • Part of the award winning Stonewall Kitchen Family of gourmet brands that includes Tillen Farms, Legal Sea Foods, Vermont Village, Montebello Pasta, Napa Valley Naturals, Urban Accents, Vermont Coffee & Village Candles; great taste runs in our family

From the manufacturer


About Us

In 1993, Village Candle flickered into life on a tiny, two-pot stove. Born from a passion for New England craftsmanship that still burns strong to this day.

From our village to your village remains our continuous inspiration all these years, as we strive to create and share memorable fragrance experiences with our valued customers while being authentic to our heritage.

Gardenia

Gardenia Blossom, Jasmine And Lily

Deep in the South secret gardens silently bloom with the most extravagant and romantic of flowers. These velvety white gardenias with their unmistakably addictive fragrance, jasmine with its lingering lusciousness, and lilies to woo the senses. Gorgeously intoxicating, this is flora to fawn over.

  • Our candles offer a long and consistent burn time of up to 170 hours (dependent on candle size).
  • Before reaching your home, each candle is quality checked and the lead-free cotton wicks are hand-trimmed by our talented team of candlemakers in Wells, Maine.
  • When you light your candle, spark an experience, and know that every time you can expect the same high-quality candles that you’ve come to know and love all these years.

How are We Different? Allow Us to Illuminate:

Candles Inspired by Life, Made Just for You.

At Village Candle we create fragrance experiences to enrich your life. From familiar things we love, to the thrill of new adventures that take you to unexpected places, we’re inspired by absolutely everything.

Dual Wick Technology.

Pioneered by Village Candle, our Dual Wick Technology ensures a cleaner, more efficient burn, as well as a superior fragrance experience. Our lead-free cotton wicks are hand-trimmed by our team before reaching your home.

High-Quality Ingredients.

We source the finest ingredients for a clean, true-to-life, long lasting, fragrance experience. Our candles are developed with the highest quality, food-grade paraffin wax and lead-free cotton wicks.

Proudly Made in Maine.

Now a global scent-sation, we’ve joined the Stonewall Kitchen Family of Brands where our highly skilled candle-makers in Wells, Maine will continue to create superior low-smoke candles that you’ve come to know and love all these years.

Product Description

These vanilla scented candles provide a comforting treat to warm up a chilly evening. Baked apples are topped with creamy vanilla ice cream, sweet honey, and warm cinnamon to create a scrumptious after-dinner-inspired scent. While this large jar candle adds home fragrance, ambience, relaxation, and comfort in the living room, bedroom, or bathroom, its appeal goes beyond scent alone. With a long burn time, it can set the ambiance, scent a space, and serve as a home decor accent with an inviting home scent. Create an experience and share memories around the table with our scented candles for home. Born from a passion for candles and craftsmanship, our scented candles are proudly made in America by highly skilled New England candlemakers.

    Safety Information

    Keep away from flammable materials. Do not leave unattended. Monitor burn time. Extinguish when not in use. Keep out of reach of children and pets. Never burn a candle completely and dispose of remnants properly.

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    Customers like the candle's scent, describing it as a nice vanilla with a hint of cinnamon, and appreciate its appearance, with one noting it's perfect for the holidays.       Reviewed in the United States on January 3, 2024

      Okay so, this is one of those serious detailed reviews because I don't play when it comes to candles! For starters lemme just say I rarely write a review on here unless I really like something I think others should buy, or really avoid buying. This is one of those candles that you just gotta get, if you are a candle person. It literally smells exactly like what it says - a spiced vanilla apple. It has made me hungry time and time again. This is esthetically pleasing, the way it lights so pretty in a dim or in a dark room is warming. My cat seems to love it and at first I did not notice the smell until after it has been lit for about an hour. This candle is about 30% used after 3 days of use (put it in the freezer, it'll last longer :P ).

      The ONLY CON -It is NOT as intense as I would love it to be. I love when a candle can be suttle in scent but still smell up the entire room, or rooms. I can only smell this candle when I'm within 2-3 feet max. Other than that, I'll be trying more from Village Candle. MAKE THEM A LITTLE MORE POWERFUL PLEASE :(

      Für mich einer der besten Winterdüfte überhaupt. Die Kombination aus Spiced Vanilla und Apple riecht unglaublich gemütlich, warm und angenehm. Perfekt für Herbst und Winter und sorgt direkt für eine schöne Atmosphäre.

      Ich habe die Kerze blind gekauft und wurde definitiv nicht enttäuscht. Für mich ein perfekter Blindkauf und einer meiner Favoriten von Village Candle.

    About this Item

    • Vanilla candles for home scented with the inviting aroma of spiced apples and topped with creamy vanilla ice cream to create a cozy atmosphere and a warm ambience
    • Large Apothecary Jar Candles that provide up to 140 hours of fragrance; Dimensions are 3.8''L x 3.8''W x 6.75''H
    • Crafted with a soy wax blend to ensure a clean, even burn and a beautifully balanced fragrance experience. Its creamy, slow-burning formula enhances both performance and presentation, making it a perfect everyday luxury or gift
    • Our expertly optimized wicks ensure a clean, controlled burn that melts wax evenly across the surface. The result is a longer-lasting candle with a beautifully consistent fragrance experience
    • Part of the award winning Stonewall Kitchen Family of gourmet brands that includes Tillen Farms, Legal Sea Foods, Vermont Village, Montebello Pasta, Napa Valley Naturals, Urban Accents, Vermont Coffee & Village Candles; great taste runs in our family

    Product Description

    These vanilla scented candles provide a comforting treat to warm up a chilly evening. Baked apples are topped with creamy vanilla ice cream, sweet honey, and warm cinnamon to create a scrumptious after-dinner-inspired scent. While this large jar candle adds home fragrance, ambience, relaxation, and comfort in the living room, bedroom, or bathroom, its appeal goes beyond scent alone. With a long burn time, it can set the ambiance, scent a space, and serve as a home decor accent with an inviting home scent. Create an experience and share memories around the table with our scented candles for home. Born from a passion for candles and craftsmanship, our scented candles are proudly made in America by highly skilled New England candlemakers.
